item.title: Canonical ABI lift/lower Cheat Sheet
item.description:
The Canonical ABI defines the mutual conversion between rich interface types defined in WIT and their corresponding representations in Core Wasm (as well as function calling conventions between components).

Since the mapping between WIT and Core Wasm types/values is quite complex and easy to forget, I am creating a cheat sheet as a personal note. It might be useful as a supplementary reader to CanonicalABI.md.

I will ignore the Future, Stream, and ErrorContext types for now.
